subject: Performance bridge request: temporary credits for latency/throughput validation
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-27T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Load-run window & temporary credits request

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for running the initial demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile. We have a constrained POC next week where we need to validate production-like load for our real-time ranking pipeline. Before we schedule the run I wanted to check if Redwood can provide a short-term credit allocation so we can execute a 3-hour sustained test.

High-level requirements:
- Target steady-state: ~250 qps (concurrent requests ~60)
- Payload: avg 3.5k tokens/request (embeddings + generation mix)
- Goal: p95 latency < 150ms, 99th < 250ms
- Preferred window: May 31, 09:00–12:00 PT

Attached is our load profile (load-profile-20270527.csv). If you can supply a temporary credit buffer or a trial extension tied to this run (and confirm any guardrails), we can proceed and share the results. We may also loop in procurement if there are contract prerequisites.

Thanks — looking forward to a quick confirmation so we can lock the window.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Senior ML Platform Engineer | OrbitAI
Attachments: load-profile-20270527.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-28T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Load-run window & temporary credits request

Lena — thanks for the clear metrics and the load profile. We can support a short burst for your POC, and I want to make sure we set appropriate limits so this doesn't inadvertently affect other runs.

Quick answers:
- We can provision a temporary credit "bridge" for the test window. I recommend a 200,000-token buffer based on the load profile you sent; if you expect higher utilization, tell us and we'll adjust.
- We need the exact run start/end times and confirmation that the test will run in the May 31 window you proposed.
- We'll require a short ops doc signed off (SLA-exception-request-form.docx) and a scoped HubSpot deal record for tracking.

Looping in Marissa (sales ops) to approve the credit allocation and Ben (solutions) to coordinate any runtime config (autoscaling policy, quantization profile) to keep p95 targets achievable.

Next steps:
1) Confirm May 31, 09:00–12:00 PT (or propose alternative).
2) Confirm if you want 200k tokens or a higher bridge.
3) Ben and I will run a quick pre-check on May 30 to validate model cfg and KV cache priming.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbitai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Load-run window & temporary credits request

Hi all — quick technical notes from the solutions side:

Thanks for the load profile, Lena. A few items to make the run smooth:
- We'll set an autoscaling policy for the test window and pin the model variant to the quantized 8-bit profile (reduces per-token cost and helps latency).
- Please confirm whether the test includes long-context sessions (KV reuse) or mostly stateless calls. If KV is used we can enable prefix caching to reduce overhead.
- Pre-run checklist (Ben -> Vivek/Lena): pre-warm KV cache, validate tokenization with sample payload, and run a 15-minute smoke at lower qps on May 30 at 16:00 PT.

Drive with test scripts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-performance-tests (I uploaded the smoke script and a template runbook).
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

If you confirm May 31 09:00–12:00 PT and accept the 200k token bridge, I'll prepare runbook steps and coordinate with infra to reserve capacity.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: SLA-exception-request-form.docx (for ops sign-off)

Lena — thanks for the details and for working with us on the run. Approved the temporary credit allocation with the conditions below.

Allocation details:
- Token bridge: 200,000 tokens allocated to OrbitAI account RDW-2027-5432
- Validity: 7 days from activation (activation tied to the run start time)
- Run window: May 31, 09:00–12:00 PT (confirmed)

Conditions / guardrails:
1) The bridge is limited to the specified token amount. Any overage will be billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates unless we agree to an alternate purchase in advance.
2) Red team (Ben) will run the May 30 16:00 PT smoke and confirm the model variant and cache priming.
3) OrbitAI should return the filled SLA-exception-request-form.docx (simple sign-off) prior to activation.
4) This is a one-time promotional allocation tied to the POC run; future requests will follow the normal trial expansion process.

Attachments: credit-allocation-approval-20270530.pdf (stub approval PDF)

I'll also create a short DocuSign for procurement to sign for audit tracking — link below once it's generated.

— Marissa Cole
